scope: Remove Chromium and executable Web Stage stack; retain Servo and SpiderMonkey. No Main/other-worktree edits or Git synchronization.

regression.scope: Native renderer, real JS/React, CPU reference/explicit buffer inputs, actual audio/PNG/EXR/video, borrow lifetime, Web refusal, SM codec. Later packaging-only fixes and final removed-analysis-preview/engine-alternative guards were checked separately; not presented as a single all-repository run.

initialRegression.reason: Removed webBridge stats field still read by the resource test; assertion migrated to absence, numerical assertions retained.

wasm.scope: Real Rust solver WASM under SpiderMonkey, explicit authorization, sealed bytes, deny imports/network/Worker, repeated disposal; Native command recording only in this probe.

servo.scope: Native→Servo→Blur→Servo PNG/video; independent Servo SDR overlay on unclipped Native HDR EXR; explicit export materialization remains.

ffmpeg.provisioning: explicit private copy; npm postinstall not run

installation.scope: Actual npm tarball, offline private install, installed bin, version/doctor/init/PNG/3-frame headless preview/analyze list; installed binaries auto-located with explicit host overrides unset.

failures: First installed tarball correctly failed inventory verification: npm omits .npmrc; build collector now excludes this packaging configuration file from copying/sealing. Integrity verification remains enabled.

Second installation test accidentally supplied an empty FRAMEWEAVE_SPIDERMONKEY; exact same installation passed after removing that test environment override. Final tarball was rebuilt and explicitly reinstalled, then all recorded consumer commands passed.
validation.postValidationChanges: EOF whitespace and evidence only after final installed tarball validation; behavioral source was frozen before that build.
untested: Full repository regression and six export modes
Interactive visible-window controls in this removal campaign
Arbitrary browser frameworks/WebGL/async DOM/WASM inside Servo
